items.title: DL 6063 JFK to LIM
items.notes: Delta 6063 operated by LATAM Airlines. Departs NYC-Kennedy (JFK), arrives Lima (LIM) Fri 21 Aug. Plus (T) fare class.

items.title: Crowne Plaza Lima by IHG
items.notes: Confirmation: 85460134. 2 nights, 3 guests. 3 Double Premium City View rooms with double beds. $630.33 total. Free cancellation until Aug 29, 2026 12:00 am local time.

items.title: Central Restaurant
items.notes: Chef Virgilio Martinez's flagship. Consistently ranked among the world's best. Tasting menu built around Peru's ecosystems and altitudes. Book reservations far in advance. Closed Sundays.

items.title: Maido
items.notes: Chef Mitsuharu Tsumura's nikkei restaurant. Japanese-Peruvian fusion. World's 50 Best regular. Closed Sundays. Reservation for 2. Confirmation ID: F922-4B40-BC14-E49B. Cancel at least 2 hours ahead.

items.title: Tomo Cocina Nikkei
items.notes: Nikkei spot, good option for a lower-key night or backup if Central doesn't work out on the 30th.

items.title: Inkaterra La Casona
items.notes: Boutique hotel in a restored colonial mansion in the Plaza Nazarenas. Confirmation: ITC-88421. 3 nights.

items.title: San Blas neighborhood
items.notes: Bohemian quarter with artisan workshops, narrow cobblestone streets. Good for an afternoon wander.

items.title: Mercado San Pedro
items.notes: Central market. Best in the morning. Good spot for breakfast and local produce.

items.title: Backroads Lodge-to-Lodge Trek
items.notes: 5-day guided trek from Cusco to Machu Picchu via Salkantay pass. Includes all lodging, meals, and porter support. Gear list provided.

items.title: Machu Picchu
items.notes: Entry tickets for 8am slot. Huayna Picchu tickets sold separately - book 6 months in advance.
